svg.title: dsh-customs-doc-check register checks: one row, seven rules, two output channels
svg.desc: The material (JSON or YAML) is normalised into 17 canonical columns after alias matching that ignores case, spaces, underscores and hyphens; at least one known column name must be recognised. Seven rules read eight of those columns: CD-001 presenceAny on goodsName + amount, CD-002 pattern ^[0-9]{10}$ on hsCode, CD-003 pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$ on currency, CD-004 uniqueness of docNo, CD-005 grossWeight >= netWeight, CD-006 a parseable declaredAt not after the check date, CD-007 placeholder terms in goodsName. Each rule leaves through one of two channels: issues[] for what it found (one warn for row 1, whose goodsName and amount are both blank) and skipped[] for what it could not run (missing column, disabled rule, only-narrowed rule), each with its own reason. A rule that ran and found nothing enters neither list. Both channels converge on one report (error 0, warn 1, info 0; issueCount 1, skippedCount 0) rendered as markdown plus reportJson under the wording guard and disclaimer, and the verdict stays with the reviewer: no compliance, classification, truthfulness or duty judgement.

text.font-family: Consolas,'Microsoft YaHei',ui-monospace,monospace
